prompt: Which pair completes BOTH passages in order? “… command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all the ______, as grain is sifted in a sieve, yet not the least kernel will …” (9:9); “All the sinners of my people will ______ by the sword, who say, 'Evil won't overtake nor meet us.'” (9:10, WEB)
